title: M4 lecture 2: a 5 kg box on a rough floor, μs 0.4 / μk 0.3 in one line; 15 N sticks, 30 N slides

lines.say: Now consider a 5 kg box on a rough horizontal floor.
The coefficients of static and kinetic friction are 0.4 and 0.3.
We push it with a force of 15 newtons.
Now we push it with 30 newtons instead.
